Specification of a fleet

Source: R/config_fishery.R
om_fleet.Rd

Helper that returns the list describing one fleet, with the fields used by om_fishery_config(). Defaults are those of fleet A of Experimento 02. Assign the result to cfg$fleets$<name> (or pass it through om_config_update()).

Usage

om_fleet(
  n_vessels = 45,
  year_start = 1950,
  year_end = 2025,
  regions = c("R01", "R02"),
  core_lon = -45,
  core_lat = 12,
  core_sd = 20,
  quarter_weights = c(0.25, 0.3, 0.25, 0.2),
  hooks_median = c(`1950` = 1300, `1980` = 1900, `2025` = 2300),
  hbf_mult = 1,
  strategy_comp = c(S1 = 0.55, S2 = 0.3, S3 = 0.15),
  q_effect = 0
)

Arguments

n_vessels

Number of vessel slots kept active (turnover replaces retiring vessels).

year_start, year_end

Period of activity.

regions

Regions the fleet can fish in (labels of the domain).

core_lon, core_lat, core_sd

Centre (degrees) and spread of the baseline spatial preference; cells are also made available from the centre outwards as the fleet expands.

quarter_weights

Relative frequency of trips per quarter (4).

hooks_median

Anchors (named by year) of the median hooks per set.

hbf_mult

Multiplier of the hooks between floats of the fleet.

strategy_comp

Composition of fishing strategies (sums to 1, names = strategy levels).

q_effect

Fleet effect on log catchability.

Value

A list.

Examples

fcfg <- om_fishery_config()
fcfg$fleets$F <- om_fleet(n_vessels = 15, year_start = 1990,
                          regions = "R02", core_lon = -10, core_lat = 0)
names(fcfg$fleets)
#> [1] "A" "B" "C" "D" "E" "F"
